verification_notes: Method limit: the session's WebSearch budget (200/200) was exhausted, so no news or roll-call searches were possible. Verification used the raw wikitext of the French Wikipedia pages Nouveau_Front_populaire, Les_Écologistes, Taxe_Zucman, Marine_Tondelier and Justice_des_mineurs_en_France (fetched with curl, with quotes checked verbatim), plus the European Greens 2024 French manifesto PDF. lesecologistes.fr returned 403 and huffingtonpost.fr was blocked. No Tondelier 2026 campaign programme text was retrievable. Her documented first priority is a 'sécurité sociale de l'alimentation'.

Context: Tondelier is not an MP, so she has no personal votes. She declared her candidacy on 22 Oct 2025 and was designated by Les Écologistes on 8 Dec 2025. The left primary failed in July 2026. The NFP June 2024 programme she co-founded is used as the latest written programme. No reversal in 2025-26 was found.
